$comment: GT-697 — closures resting on a class production never reaches, frozen when the detector was written. This list may only SHRINK. Removing an entry requires either wiring the class or reopening the gap. Regenerate with --write-baseline ONLY when deliberately re-baselining, and say so in the commit.

entries.why: Reachable from this package public root through a chain of re-exports, in a package published to npm. Consumers are external by design. NOT proof of use — a declared export is not an observed one — but no internal call site is EXPECTED, so this is not the GT-321 defect.
Constructed only by its own 1 spec file(s); git history shows it was NEVER constructed in production, on any commit. Not a regression — never connected.
